title: Broken Glass Shader - Refraction & Diffraction Optical Surface
summary: Physically-inspired real-time broken glass surface shader for Unity3D featuring normal-mapped shattered crack patterns, optical refraction, chromatic diffraction, and Fresnel specular highlights.
highlights: Realistic light refraction and chromatic diffraction driven by custom normal map displacement textures.
Adjustable glass tint, specular reflection falloff, and Fresnel sheen accentuating shattered shard edges and radial impact points.
Published on the Unity Asset Store as a lightweight, drop-in material compatible with forward and deferred rendering pipelines.
